title: Cue card (radiation.cue_card/0.2) — P-11-B reconciliation + admission gate
description: Typed record per operational cue: id, version, kind, scope, trigger, priority, conflicts_with, precedence, action, effect, evidence, tests, authority_grant, review_after. Precedence LAW: commander_order > ratified_policy > cue > heuristic > content CONTENT-only. Authority-granting cues MUST carry review_after (linter FAIL otherwise). Non-boot catalog (check 41/42). Executed by cue_resolver.py (check 42). P-11-B adds review_after + authority_grant per II.7.8 reconciliation.

authority_grant.description: True if cue grants authority/scope (build autonomy, standing permission, budget override, ratification pass, continuous-op, overrule, etc). If true, review_after MUST be present (linter FAIL otherwise). P-11-B admission gate.

review_after.description: Expiry/review date for authority-granting cues. If authority_grant true, this field is required. Past date = historical note only (expired). Future date = active grant with review deadline. P-11-B.
